paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, akum sagihna, akha ngana, huai kha ani sawm ni in Israel Upa kuate hiam TOUPA thu dong ding in ahong pai ua, ka ma ah atu uhi.
heading: TOUPA Deihlam Leh Mite Simmohhuaina

paite: Huan ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a: ka kiang ah,

"Mihing tapa, Israel upate houpih inla, akiang uah, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Kei thudong dia hong pai na hi uh hia? Kei ka hin bang in, noute thudot in ka om kei ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi," chi in.
Amaute vai na hawmsak ding hia, mihing tapa, amaute vai na hawmsak ding hia? Apate uh kihhuainate thei uh hen.

Huan akiang uah, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Israelte ka tel ni a Jakob inkote telte kiang ah ban zak hial a Aigupta gam a akiang ua ka kitheihsak a, akiang ua ka khut ka zak a, Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi, ka chih.
Huai ni a Aigupta gam a kipan pikhia a, amah a dia gam kham, nawitui leh khuaizu a luang gam, gam tengteng a kilawmpen a pilut ding a ka khut ka zak ni in akiang uah:
Michih in na mit ua muh thilkihhuai paimang unla, Aigupta gam a milimte in kihihnin kei un, kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi, chi in ka gen hi.

Himahleh, ka tung ah ahel ua, hon limsak kei ua, michih in amit ua muh thilkihhuaite leng apaimang kei ua, Aigupta milimte leng alehngatsan sam kei uh. Huai ah atung ua ka hehna lungdamsak ding in Aigupta gamsung ngei ah atung uah ka hehna ka leihbo kei na diam, ka chi hi.
Himahleh, keimah min ziak in ka gamtang zawta a, a-omna namte uh mitmuh in Aigupta gam a kipan pikhia in akiang uah ka kitheisakta; huai namte mitmuh a ka min gensiat a a-omlouhna ding in.
Huchi in Aigupta gam pawtsan ding in ka chita a, gamdai ah ka hon pilut hi.
Ka dan bawlte amaute ka pia a, ka dan thukhunte ka ensak a, huai tuh mi'n azuih ua ahinna ding un.
Huai lou leng kei leh amaute kikal achiamtehna ding in ka Sabbathte amau ka pia a, kei TOUPA, amaute koihtuampa ka hi chih atheihtheihna ding un.

Himahleh Israel inkote gamdai ah ka tung ah ahel ua, ka dan bawlte azui kei ua, ka thugelte, mi'n ahih a ahinna ding tak uh apaikhia ua, nakpitak in ka Sabbath abohsia ua; huchi in gamdai ah amaute hihmang ding in atung uah ka hehna ka leih kei na diam aw, ka chi hi.
Ka pikhiak lai in athei mite nam mahmah mitmuh a hihsiat a a-omlouhna ding un ka min ziak in ka gamtang zawta hi.
Huai lou in huai gamdai ah ka gam piak, nawitui leh khuaizu a luang gam, gam tengteng a kilawmpen ah ka pilut kei ding, ban zak hial in ka chi hi.
Ka thugelhte apaikhia ua, ka dan bawlte azui kei ua, ka Sabbathte abohsiat ziak un; alungtang un amilimte uh azui uhi.
Himahleh hihmang lou ding in ka mit in amuh maihta a, gam ah leng ka hihmang vekta kei hi.
Huan gamdai ah atate uh kiang ah: Na pipute uh dan bawl zui kei unla, athugelte uh zui kei unla, amilimte un kihihnin sam kei un;
Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi, ka dan bawlte zui unla, ka thugelte vom unla, zui un.
Ka Sabbath tang unla, kei leh noute kikal a chiamtehna ahi ding a, TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi chih na theihna ding un, ka chi hi.

Himahleh atate uh ka tung ah ahel ua, ka dan thukhunte azui kei ua, ka thugelte, mi'n ahih a ahinna ding tak, zui ding in avom sam kei uh. Sabbath ni abohseta ua; gamdai ah ka hehna lungdamsak ding in atung uah ka hehna ka leih kei na hiam, ka chi hi.
Himahleh ka khut ka kideksak a, ka pikhiak lai athei mite nam ngei mitmuh a hihsiat a a-omlouhna ding un ka min ziak in ka gamtang zawta ahi.
Huai lou leng, namte lak ah amau ka dalhsak ding a, gam chih ah ka thelthangsak ding, gamdai ah ban zak hial in ka na chi hi.
Ka thugelte zui lou a, ka dan bawlte paikhia a, ka Sabbath ni bohsia a, apipute uh milim lam angat ziak un.
Huai lou leng, dan bawlhoih lou ka pia a, ahinlouhna ding ua thugelte toh;
athiltan uh, sul hong tengtengte'n mei a apaihna uah amaute ka hihnin a, ka lungzuangsak a, atawp a TOUPA ka hi chih atheihna ding un.
Huaiziak in mihing tapa, akiang uah thu gen inla, akiang uah, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: “Na pate un hiaite ah ahon gense lailai uhi, ka tung a tatlekna thil ahihte uah.

Ban zak hial a amaute ka chiam gam ah ka hon pilut in, mual sang leh singbuk lian amuh peuhmah uah akithoihnate uh alan ua, athillat uh hehhuai mahmahte apia uh. Agimlimte uh abawl ua, adawn ding thillatte uh abungkhia uh," chi in.
Huchi in ke'n akiang uah, mun sang a na hoh nak uh bang na chihna uh ahia? ka chi a; huchi in amin a ding in tuni tan in, Bamah, chih ahita hi.
Huchi in Israel inkote kiang ah gen inla, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Na pipute uh bang zel in noumau na kihihnin un akihhuaina bang un hupmang na hi ding uh maw?

Na thil tan uh na lan un, na tate uh mei ah na pai ua, tuni tan in na milimte tengteng un na kihihnin uh ahi kei maw? Noute thudot ding ka hi a hia, aw Israel inkote aw? Kei ka hin bang in noute thudot in ka om kei ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
I kim ua namdang pau tuam mite bang a singbul suangbul be ding i hi uh, na lungsim ua na chih uh, atangtung himhim kei ding.
Kei ka hin bang in, khut thagui hattak in, ban zak kawm leh heh suah in na tung uah vai ka hawm ngeingei ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
heading: Pathian Gawtna Leh Ngaihdamna

paite: Namte lak a kipan ka hon pikhe ding a, dalhsak a na omna gam ua kipan khut hattak leh ban zak leh heh suah in ka hon pikhawm ding.
Pau tuam mite gamdai gam ah ka hon pilut ding a, kimaituah in i kisual ding uh.
Aigupta gam gamdai a na pipute uh ka sual bangtak in nou leng ka hon sual ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
Chiang nuai ah ka hon lutsak ding a, thukhun delhkhumna nuai ah ka hon pilut ding hi;

Huan na lak ua kipan mihelte leh ka tung a talek mite ka khuahsiang ding a, a-omna gam ua kipan in ka pikhe ding a, himahleh Israel gam ah alut het kei ding uh; huchi in TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uh.

Noute ahihleh, Aw Israel inkote aw, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Ka thu na ngaihkhiak kei uleh tunung chiang in na milim nna uh sem chiat maita unla; himahleh ka min siangthou bel na thilpiakte uleh na milimte un na hihninta kei ding uhi.

Ka tang siangthou, Israel sanna tang ah, huai ah Israel inkote tengteng in avek un, huai gam ah ka nna asem ding uh; huai ah amaute ka paktata dia, huai ah na thillatte uh na thilpiak hoih tatate uh, na thil tan tengteng uh ka deihta ding.

Namte lak a kipan ka hon lakkhiak hun chiang in leh gam chih a na dalhna ua kipan ka hon pikhawm hun chiang in, gimlim ding in noute ka hon sangta ding a, namte mitmuh in noute ah ka sianthoudan alangta ding, Toupa PATHIAN in achi hi.
Huan Israel gam, ban zak hial a na pipute uh piak ka chiam gam a noute ka hon pilut hun chiang in TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uh.
Huan huai ah na omdante uleh na thilhih uh, na kihihnitna tengteng uh na theita ding uh; huchi in na thil hoih lou hih tengtengte uh ziak in noute mitmuh ngei in na kihta ding uhi.

Na omdan hoihloute uh bang hilou a, na thilhih uh thulimloute bang leng hi sam lou a, ka min ziak a noute ka hon pichinsak hun chiang in, aw Israel inkote aw, TOUPA ka hi chih na theita ding uh, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi, chi in.
TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a, ka kiang ah,
heading: Simlam A Mei

paite: "Mihing tapa, simlam masuan inla, simlam nga in na thu khah inla, simlam gammangpi lam ah thu gen inla,

simlam gammangpi kiang ah, TOUPA thu ngai in, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Ngai in, nang ah mei ka toh ding a, nang ah sing hing tengteng akangbei ding a, sing keu peuhmah leng; meikuang luahluah adai kei ding, sim a kipan mal tanpha in, matuah teng akangvom ding hi.
Huan mi tengteng in kei TOUPA meikhahpa ka hi chih amu ding ua, amit kei ding, chi in," achi hi.
Huchi in ke'n, "Ah! Toupa PATHIAN, gentehna thugenmi lel ahi kei maw? ahon chi ding uh," ka chi hi.
